maintenance_led.reason: Sells new apparel and footwear (Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer, Johnny Was) to consumers; first-time purchases, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and wholesale retail customers buying premium apparel, not from government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own brands, retail stores and e-commerce; acquires brands only occasionally (Johnny Was, Southern Tide).

mission_critical.reason: Discretionary fashion apparel; consumers and wholesale buyers can easily switch to other brands without disruption.
